fast.name: Blade Dancer
fast.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: King Down Chess Workshop sample character sprite sheet.
Generate an original FAST character called Blade Dancer as a transparent 1536 × 1024 landscape PNG. Exactly TWO full-body renderings of the SAME character in one sheet: ivory army version on the LEFT, charcoal army version on the RIGHT. Identical face, body, anatomy, costume, pose and scale, with only army color changed.
The two supplied reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their hand-painted fantasy board-game illustration, crisp dark edge lines, softly painted volume, readable broad forms and slightly exaggerated anatomy. Do not copy either reference character's identity, weapon or costume. Do not copy their dark background. This is a painted 2D figure, not a realistic 3D render, not anime.
Subject: a lean adult woman with swept-back tied hair, short layered split tunic, narrow lightweight leather armour, and TWO short crescent blades held separately low beside her body. One knee slightly bent in a poised light ready stance. Clear negative space at both elbows and between her legs; her two hands and two blades are anatomically clear. Both versions face slightly three-quarter toward the viewer's RIGHT. Only one property is suggested: FAST, through her light outfit and poised silhouette; no magical effects.
Army palette dominates at least 85% of each whole figure, including hair, skin, clothes and blades: warm ivory / soft stone-white shades on left; deep charcoal / slate shades on right. A tiny muted desaturated blue tie accent only. Dark ink outlines and modest neutral highlights. No bright multicolor costume.
Composition: left character fully inside left half and right character fully inside right half. Equal height, head tops around y=120 and full soles near y=960. Generous completely transparent gutters around every contour, including blade tips and feet, and between the figures. Keep complete hair, hands, blades, clothing and feet visible, with no cropping. Broad readable silhouette and refined painted detail similar to reference.
Background must be real alpha transparency everywhere outside the two figures, no opaque backdrop, no checkerboard graphic. NO bases, plinths, pedestals, contact shadows, cast shadows, floor, scenery, halos, smoke, speed streaks, text, captions, labels or watermarks. NO hood, helmet, crown, full cloak, bow, staff, horse head or wrench.
fast.framing_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The FIRST image is the Blade Dancer sprite sheet to edit. The SECOND and THIRD images are style references only.
Correct ONLY the framing of the first image: scale the two complete figures down uniformly and position each safely inside its own half of a transparent 1536 × 1024 canvas. Preserve both figures exactly: identity, anatomy, face, pose, full paired crescent blades, costume, color, hand-painted finish and all details. Do not redesign them.
Each figure must fit inside a maximum 600-pixel-wide by 840-pixel-tall region. Left figure centered at x=384; right figure centered at x=1152. Character tops around y=120 and complete soles no lower than y=960. Their blade tips must remain inside their respective halves with a minimum 64-pixel transparent margin from the central divider and outer canvas edges. The figure height may be smaller to respect blade-tip margins; preserve each figure's aspect ratio and identical scale.
Remove all background RGB imagery and retain genuine clean alpha transparency around figures. NO background, shadow, floor, scene, base, text, checkerboard, glow or vignette. Do not add anything. Full feet, complete blade tips, hair and all hands remain visible. Export genuine transparent PNG.

strong.name: Ram Bastion
strong.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: King Down Chess Workshop sample character sprite sheet.
Generate an original STRONG character called Ram Bastion as a genuinely transparent 1536 × 1024 landscape PNG. Exactly TWO full-body renderings of the SAME character: ivory army version on LEFT, charcoal army version on RIGHT. Same head, anatomy, costume, pose and scale in both; only the army color changes.
The two supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their hand-painted fantasy board-game illustration, crisp dark edge lines, softly painted volume, readable broad forms and slightly exaggerated anatomy. Do not copy either reference's identity, weapon or costume. Do not reproduce their background. This is a painted 2D figure, not realistic 3D rendering, not anime.
Subject: stocky upright ram-headed guardian with an unmistakable animal RAM head, TWO large curled ram horns, a short broad ovine muzzle, small animal ears, broad shoulders and thick compact limbs. Heavy segmented shoulder and forearm armour; enormous flat rectangular boxing-like metal gauntlets, fists down and apart; a short split apron. Strong cloven hooves, no human feet. Planted wide stance, both feet fully visible, facing slightly three-quarter to the viewer's RIGHT. Clear negative space separating both arms and gauntlets from the torso and between the legs. Sole visual property STRONG: mass and planted stance, no magical effects, symbols or extra gimmicks.
Army color dominates at least 85% of each entire figure, including fur, horns, armor, apron and hooves: warm stone-ivory on the LEFT, deep charcoal / slate on the RIGHT. Dark crisp outlines and restrained neutral painted shading. At most a tiny muted desaturated red clasp accent. Broad simple armor panels, no ornate filigree.
Composition is critical: each entire figure inside a 600-pixel-wide × 840-pixel-tall area within its half. Left centered x=384; right centered x=1152. Horn tops around y=120, soles near y=960. At least 64 pixels of transparent margin from either outer edge and center divide; generous empty alpha gutters all around. Identical scale and posture. Full horns, gauntlets, apron and hooves; do not crop.
Actual alpha transparency outside the two characters, with clean antialiased contours and no residual background haze. No backdrop, checkerboard graphic, base, plinth, pedestal, floor, shadow, glow, light rays, smoke, scenery, labels, text or watermark. No enclosed helmet, tower silhouette, human face, bare ogre body, sword, spear, shield, horse head, wrench, cloak or cape.
strong.framing_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The FIRST image is the Ram Bastion sprite sheet to edit. The SECOND and THIRD images are style references only.
Correct ONLY the first image's framing: scale each complete ram figure down uniformly and center it within its own half of a transparent 1536 × 1024 PNG. Preserve the figures themselves exactly: same animal ram heads with two curled horns each, pose, anatomy, massive rectangular gauntlets, cloven hooves, segmented armour, painted finish and ivory/charcoal palette. Do not redesign or change costume.
Each figure must be no more than 580 pixels wide. Left character centered at x=384, with all content within x=94..674; right character centered at x=1152, all content within x=862..1442. Preserve original aspect ratio, so scale both equally. Horn tops near y=150, hooves no lower than y=930. A large visibly empty transparent gap must separate the two ram figures: neither gauntlet may enter the center gap. At least 90 pixels clear alpha from outer canvas edges, and at least 90 pixels from each character's nearest contour to x=768. Full horns, hands, apron, legs and hooves remain intact.
All space around the figures is genuine alpha transparency. No backdrop, floor, gradient, smoke, glow, scene, base, plinth, cast shadow, contact shadow, checkerboard pattern, text or added objects. Remove residual background haze and retain clean antialiased contours.
